summary.text: Rosie Lynch is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican David Nelson in a race with no incumbent.
She describes herself as a community advocate and volunteer focused on rural Oklahoma, and she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Lynch was born in Sayre, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Manheim Central High School.
She earned an associate degree from Tulsa Community College in 2008 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Tulsa in 2011, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as director.
Lynch lost the 2024 general election for District 16 to incumbent Republican Scott Fetgatter.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said her key priorities were addressing homelessness, job instability and food insecurity, expanding rural and mental health care, and connecting services with rural communities.
She also listed public education, veterans services and higher education among the committees that interested her.
